events.title: Night Shift: 1999 Heads to Melbourne Games Week + New Screen Australia Funding
events.summary: A couple of big pieces of news from the night shift. We’re incredibly happy to share that Night Shift: 1999 has been selected for the Games Week Showcase at Melbourne International Games Week 2026, taking place at ACMI this October. The Games Week Showcase brings together more than 120 indie games from Australia and around the world, with Night Shift: 1999 appearing as part of the Wobbly showcase. events.title: Welcome to the very first dev log for Night Shift: 1999
events.summary: Welcome to the very first dev log for Night Shift: 1999, a narrative visual novel set in the neon-shadows of Kings Cross, Sydney during the final year of the millennium. I’m Georgina Owassapian, the creator and developer behind the project. In this introductory episode, I am introducing you to this world and discuss how I am weaving themes of vampire lore with the real-world complexities of migrant identity. events.title: Night Shift: 1999 Featured on ScreenHub
events.summary: We're excited to share a new interview with Night Shift: 1999 creator Georgina Owassapian, recently published by ScreenHub.In the interview, Georgina discusses the inspirations behind Night Shift: 1999, including her own experiences migrating to Australia and how those experiences helped shape the game's story of identity, belonging, and reinvention through the lens of vampire fiction. events.title: NIGHTSHIFT 1999 Heads to Frosty Games Fest & PBS Radio
